title: ID0379370-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R7 313065117143] Router doesn't read sim card
description:
Reported behavior/ issue:
Router doesn't read sim card.
While router-1 reads sim card during commissioning, router-2 didn't read sim card. Although we tried different sim cards, it writes 'Sim not inserted' on the router interface. We think the router may be faulty...
Root cause:
Solution: Router replaced
